name: report_narrate
title: Narrate a report run
description:
Model-written commentary on a stored report run, checked first: every figure and date must match the run's data or its computed comparisons (changes, shares). Unmatched figures get one revision, then are removed and named in caveats. A text section waiting for commentary receives it.
Returns: commentary, label, model, revised, rejected, removed, caveats, sections, stored_in.
Inputs: run_id (from report_run or report_history); sections; length (short, medium, long); audience.
Runner and administrators only.
Example: {"run_id": "daily_risk-20261009T073000-abc123", "length": "short"}

run_id.description: The run to narrate, as report_run, report_<name> or report_history return it

sections.description: Section ids to narrate; default the sections the definition's narrate names, else every section

length.description: About 90, 180 or 350 words; default the definition's narrate length, else short

audience.description: Who the commentary is for, such as "risk committee"

model.description: The model that wrote the commentary

label.description: Shown with the commentary: it is model-written

revised.description: Whether the first draft was sent back for one revision

rejected.description: Figures and dates of the first draft that the run does not support

removed.description: Figures and dates still unsupported after the revision, removed from the commentary

comparisons.description: Computed comparisons the check accepted as quantities

stored_in.description: The run's text section the commentary was stored in, when the definition asks for it
